app.name: ScummVM (IO optimization test RPX)
app.coder: ScummVM Team; Wii U port by Rrhapsod
app.long_description: Retains the validated SDL audio timer fix. Sequential audio index reading and SCI read-only volume size caching; hardware speedup not yet measured. Read TESTING.md. Back up saves and config. Non-Aroma RPX unverified. No games or MT-32 ROMs included.
